title: Earl Palmer and musicians who could play everything
summary: Nobody better than Earl Palmer; years ago players could play everything, today they are in categories and some cannot read.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Who's your favorite drummer? Who could play? Right now, today? No, not today. What's the thing about, William?

You know, uh, there was nobody better than Earl Palmer, man, for recording, for whatever. You know, I remember Earl, Earl one time, we was in the Dew Drop, and this drummer came down here. He OD'd. He came down here with Roy Brown. Heck of a drummer. I can't remember his name. But boy, he could play. But boy, he could play. And so, one night, we was all in the Dew Drop listening to him. And, uh, when he finished, I told Earl, I said, why don't you go ahead and sit in, man? He said, man, the captain played everything. He said, ain't nothing left to play. But you see, that's what it was years ago. So, let me see, when you say play, today the drummers are in categories where they can play, they can play this new rhythm type thing. But when you switch over and say you got to play some jazz, some swing, they can't do it. But years ago, when you say a drummer, that meant he played everything. Saxophone player, he played everything. Guitar player, he played everything. But today, they're all in the category. And they play. See, guy come to me, well, I know musicians who won't play with me now. They know me. They don't play with me because they know I always have music. And they said, because they don't know about no music, they're afraid to play with me.

And, uh, now there's one guitar player, I like him. I don't like his way. I don't like the way he dressed. I have things I like to change from him. And, uh, he called me to accept me. In fact, I'm looking for him to call me. If I could get him, but he can't read. See, see. I don't know about no music. See, that's the other thing I hate. These musicians have got, they can get a guitar or bass or whatever, and go sit down with them records and learn how the records go. Most likely they don't know what key they're in. But they call themselves musicians. But they're the ones that make it hard.
